eventDetail.scope: The main target of the 2026 IEEE East-West Design & Test Symposium (EWDTS) is to exchange experiences between scientists and technologies from Eastern and Western Europe, as well as North America and other parts of the world, in the field of testing, diagnosis, repair of microelectronic systems, and also cyber security, automotive, IoT, artificial intelligence. The symposium is typically held in countries around East Europe, the Black Sea, the Balkans and Central Asia region.
